title: Antiquarian
name: Josephine
description: The Antiquarian is a relic dealer and scholar from the deserts of the east, with an appraiser's eye for anything old, rare or valuable. She is no fighter and makes no pretence of being one: she is here to find what the Estate has buried, turn it into coin for the expeditions, and lend her knowledge where it pays. Beneath the merchant is a woman who has already killed once for power, and is hunting the last piece of a box that promises far more of it.
history: The Antiquarian learned her trade in the bazaars of the Levantine, buying and selling antiques until she could tell a true relic from a forgery by touch. Wanting more than trade could give her, she apprenticed herself to a sorcerer, and for years assisted in his rites and human sacrifices, until she stabbed him in the back and bound his essence into her censer. From him, she stole the second of three pieces of a puzzle box containing great power. She has come to the Estate for the third.
summary: A greedy relic hunter who killed her master for his power, and has come to the Estate for the last piece of a prize she will have at any cost.

appearance.features: Dark, heavy-lidded eyes (lower face hidden by scarf)

clothing.head: Blue-grey headscarf, red scarf over the lower face
clothing.body: Sand-coloured robe with wide sleeves, cinched with a dark belt
clothing.legs: Long robe skirts under a tasselled red sash
clothing.accessories: Strings of heavy beads, brass bangles, a satchel and pouches

magic: Her master's power, bound in her censer
notes: Knows many of the world's languages, and slips foreign phrases into her speech
Sleeps poorly, haunted by the fear that the master bound in her censer will one day break free
An expert appraiser, who will hold forth on any old relic's age, origin and craftsmanship if given half a chance
Greedy, but shrewd about it: never risks a good arrangement for a quick gain, and always settles her share up front
